name: threadpost
description: Website conversations in your messaging inbox.

scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build
scripts.test:integration: bun test tests/core.test.ts tests/d1-store.test.ts tests/http.test.ts tests/library.test.ts tests/messaging-app.test.ts tests/messaging-store.test.ts tests/recovery.test.ts tests/telegram-settings.test.ts tests/telegram-roundtrip.test.ts tests/lifecycle-integration.test.ts
scripts.test:e2e: bun run build && bun scripts/browser-smoke.ts && bun scripts/messaging-e2e.ts
scripts.test:regression: bun test tests/lifecycle-integration.test.ts && bun run check:messaging
scripts.check:all: bun run check && bun scripts/browser-smoke.ts && bun scripts/messaging-e2e.ts
